payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image, or is there concrete visual evidence that this same mug moved toward that position?
condition.criteria: Compare source and edited images, tracking the source mug by visible appearance and continuity. Score only the requested placement of that source mug relative to the headphones. Full fulfillment requires the source mug to be identifiable and visibly to the right of the headphones. Partial fulfillment requires concrete visual evidence that the source mug itself moved toward the right, even if it has not reached a position to the right. A blurred remnant at the original location, newly appearing mugs, or an unidentifiable mug do not establish movement or identity; if the evidence cannot establish whether the source mug moved, leave fulfillment unresolved. Changes to the headphones or other objects are not progress on this endpoint.
condition.binding: SOURCE: one light-blue mug left of the headphones. EDITED: a blurred blue shape remains at the left, and two light-colored mugs appear, one near the headphones and one to their right. The edited mugs are not visually established as the source mug; do not infer movement from their locations. The headphones are also altered, which is unrelated to the requested mug placement.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position of the mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: This relative placement is the requested edit, and the mug must be the source mug rather than a newly appearing or duplicate mug.
condition.zero_when: There is no concrete visual evidence that the source mug moved toward the right of the headphones; a blurred remnant at its original location or a different mug appearing elsewhere does not count.
condition.half_when: Concrete visual continuity shows that the source mug itself moved toward the right of the headphones, but it has not yet reached a position to their right. If identity or movement cannot be established, use an unresolved score rather than partial credit.
condition.full_when: The source mug is clearly identifiable in the edited image and is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
